name: family-on
note: Both renderer-family refinements enabled together: cleanBasketFamily (G2, after baskets) and teeFamily (G3, after tees), everything else default. Combines configs/clean-basket-family-on.json and configs/tee-family-on.json's execution insertions and gate deviations into one config; both features keep their registry-default knobs. Used by tests/unit/familyDeviationSweep.test.ts as an observational A/B against default.json across the corpus.
